method: Manual contemporaneous public HTML review, checked web pages; this JSON pins editorial notes and URLs but does NOT archive or SHA-hash remote pages. Institutional reporters may reuse a single underlying witness.
review_scope: Specific report identities and dated episode distinction, not independent verification of casualties or UCDP state-based eligibility.

cases.evidence_of_distinct_dates: African Parks' 11 February bulletin distinguishes complex 8 February ambush/reinforcement attack and another IED incident on 10 February; UNESCO independently published a statement specifying both dates. ICG also describes 8 February deaths and one 10 February death.
cases.deaths_disagreement: African Parks 11 Feb lists eight fatalities in aggregate for 8+10 Feb, while ICG March trend says 8 fatalities on 8 Feb plus one on 10 Feb (nine). Differences in tallies require source reconciliation and cannot be resolved from shared journalism alone.
cases.source_role_warning: African Parks is an involved park management organisation; UNESCO is a separate institution but it is not proven to have independent forensic victim enumeration. ICG's fatality summary is not an independently verified roster.

original_source_evidence.supports: 8 Feb initial report; fatality figures preliminary
distinct 8 Feb and 10 Feb IED attacks; eight combined fatalities according to update
two dated attacks on 8 Feb and 10 Feb; no independent nominal victim list
eight dead in 8 Feb attacks and one in separate 10 Feb incident; secondary fatality count

cases.unchanged_hypothetical_counterfactual: Deleting GED 431254 changes 30 to 22 but independent evidence does not justify deleting the 8 Feb attack. A one-fatality discrepancy in the combined Feb toll, if substantiated and not offset, would instead give annual 29, above threshold; this scenario is not an actual correction.

cases.evidence_of_distinct_dates: Uganda Police Force 24 June 2022 identifies one killed in a Makindye security operation on 5 June and a second different person killed in a thwarted robbery in Old Kampala on 2 June. GED records reproduce these distinct reported dates, locations and separate cases.
cases.shared_reporting_origin: Both UCDP records cite the same Uganda Police Force communique and a news article repeating its information; two citations are not two independent victim witnesses.
cases.source_role_warning: The Uganda Police Force was the actor involved in the operations; police attribution of terror-financing connections to ADF is an interested-party claim, not independent proof of the deceased persons' militant status.

original_source_evidence.supports: two separate individuals killed June 2 in Old Kampala and June 5 in Makindye; allege financing ADF
media reports same police briefing; not an independent determination of organized-conflict eligibility

cases.classification_risk: A reported foiled robbery and another police operation against alleged terror-financing suspects are not automatically equivalent to verified direct state-based combat against IS. UCDP classification requires further actor/organized-violence evidence; no recoding is justified solely by a police press release.
cases.unchanged_hypothetical_counterfactual: Deleting either of two GED records would change annual 25 to 24, but existing sources distinguish the persons. The remaining open question is the correctness of state-based conflict eligibility, not duplicate counting.
